classification.difficultyReason: Generate alternative valid names using collinear points and reversed arm order.

content.prompt: Write four different names for the marked angle.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle ACD with B on AC, segment BD and a red interior angle arc at A.
spec.mathematics: A, B and C are collinear, with B between A and C. The selected angle has vertex A and arms AC and AD. Coordinates reproduce qualitative geometry only; no numerical dimensions are student givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Geometry and selected-angle arc are visible; angle names belong only to answers.

answer.worked: The vertex $A$ stays in the middle. Choose $B$ or $C$ on one arm and $D$ on the other, then reverse the outer letters: $\angle CAD,\ \angle BAD,\ \angle DAB,\ \angle DAC$.
